verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Bun's package management features (lockfiles, workspaces, caching, audits) but contains no mention of a mechanism to pin or switch Bun/Node runtime versions per project via a checked-in config file (e.g., a .bun-version or engines-based version switcher). This capability is plausible for a JS toolchain tool, but nothing in the docs or community evidence demonstrates it.
